summary: Teck Resources filed a Form 6-K reporting unaudited Q1 2026 results. The press release highlights record copper sales and financial performance, mentioning an ongoing merger of equals with Anglo American but providing no new details or definitive agreement. The filing is a routine earnings release, not a special-situation announcement. As a foreign private issuer, Form 6-K serves as the equivalent of a US earnings press release. No specific deal terms, board recommendations, or structural mechanics are disclosed. Watch for further merger updates; risk-arb angle is premature without binding terms.
